description.p: Simplevoice records your microphone and turns speech into text on your desktop. Local Whisper models can transcribe entirely on your device, so recordings do not need to leave your computer.

Start recording from the application window or tray menu, then copy or type the result into another application. Simplevoice also keeps a searchable local transcription history and shows usage statistics.
Optional cloud providers are available when you configure your own API key. Simplevoice has no telemetry, and local transcription remains available without an account.
